title: Add user search endpoint
diff:
diff --git a/app/api/routes/users.py b/app/api/routes/users.py
--- a/app/api/routes/users.py
+++ b/app/api/routes/users.py
@@ -1,4 +1,13 @@
+from fastapi import APIRouter
+from app.db import connection
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+@router.get("/users/search")
+async def search_users(name: str):
+    cursor = connection.cursor()
+    query = f"SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE name = '{name}'"
+    cursor.execute(query)
+    return cursor.fetchall()

name: Clean PR
title: Add invoice lookup endpoint
diff:
diff --git a/app/api/routes/invoices.py b/app/api/routes/invoices.py
--- a/app/api/routes/invoices.py
+++ b/app/api/routes/invoices.py
@@ -1,4 +1,22 @@
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
+import structlog
+from app.auth import get_current_user
+from app.repository.invoices import InvoiceRepository
+from app.schemas import InvoiceOut, User
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1")
+logger = structlog.get_logger()
+
+@router.get("/invoices/{invoice_id}", response_model=InvoiceOut)
+async def get_invoice(invoice_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), repo: InvoiceRepository = Depends()) -> InvoiceOut:
+    try:
+        invoice = await repo.get_for_user(invoice_id, user.id)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        logger.error("invoice_lookup_failed", invoice_id=invoice_id)
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail="lookup failed") from exc
+    return invoice
